activities.description: Members and volunteers planted mangrove seedlings along the creek to mark Kenya's national day for the environment.
Celebrate the republic by giving back to the creek. We will plant mangroves on the northern bank and clear plastic from the shoreline. Gumboots and tools are provided.
A day of local food, music and storytelling about how the community has lived with the mangroves for generations.

days.name: World Wetlands Day
days.about: Celebrating wetlands, including the mangroves and creeks that protect our coast.

days.name: World Wildlife Day
days.about: Celebrating wild animals and plants, like the birds, crabs and fish that live in the mangroves.

days.name: International Day of Forests
days.about: Raising awareness of every kind of forest, mangrove forests included.

days.name: Labour Day
days.about: Honouring Kenya's workers, including the community members who restore the creek.

days.name: Madaraka Day
days.about: Celebrating the day Kenya attained self-rule.

days.name: World Environment Day
days.about: The world's biggest day for action on the environment.

days.name: World Oceans Day
days.about: Celebrating the ocean, which healthy mangroves help to protect.

days.name: World Mangrove Day
days.about: The International Day for the Conservation of the Mangrove Ecosystem: our biggest day of the year.

days.name: Mazingira Day
days.about: Kenya's national day for environmental conservation and tree planting.

days.name: Utamaduni Day
days.about: Celebrating Kenya's many cultures and heritage.
